Rewrite the file /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/CROBOT/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx to be a production-grade SaaS dashboard. This is for CROBOT — an AI-powered CRO audit tool.

CRITICAL: Must NOT feel AI-generated. Must feel like Hotjar/Linear/Vercel dashboard quality.

Issues to fix:
1. Add time-based greeting using getTimeGreeting() from @/lib/score-utils
2. Add user's name from MOCK_USER
3. KPI cards need more depth — add a mini sparkline or trend context
4. Add an "Actionable Insights" card that highlights top 3 quick wins across all scans
5. Add scan usage progress bar (2/3 scans used this month) with upgrade nudge
6. Recent scans table needs relative dates ("2h ago", "Yesterday") using formatRelativeDate from @/lib/score-utils
7. Show scan page_title instead of just hostname
8. Add an empty state for when there are 0 scans (first-time user)
9. Score distribution chart needs better styling

Available imports:
- @/components/shared/PageHeader, KpiCard, ScoreRing, UrlInput, PageTransition, EmptyState
- @/components/ui/* (Card, Table, Badge, Button, Progress, Separator, etc.)
- @/lib/mock-data: MOCK_DASHBOARD_STATS, MOCK_SCANS, MOCK_SCORE_DISTRIBUTION, MOCK_SCORE_TREND, MOCK_USER
- @/lib/score-utils: getScoreColor, getTimeGreeting, formatRelativeDate
- recharts: BarChart, Bar, XAxis, YAxis, ResponsiveContainer, Cell, LineChart, Line, Area, AreaChart
- lucide-react icons
- react-router-dom Link
- @/lib/utils cn

The dashboard layout:
1. Greeting header with user name + time-based greeting + scan usage bar
2. 4 KPI cards row (Total Scans, Avg Score, Issues Found, Quick Wins Available)
3. 3-column grid:
   - Left (col-span-2): Recent Scans table with relative dates, page titles, mini ScoreRings
   - Right (col-span-1): 
     a. Quick Scan card with UrlInput
     b. Score Trend mini chart (AreaChart showing weekly avg score)
4. Full-width "Top Quick Wins" card showing 3 highest-impact, lowest-effort findings from MOCK_PILLAR_RESULTS

Write the COMPLETE file. Export as default. Make it feel like a real data-rich SaaS dashboard.
